reviews.comment: Overall Professor Hinojosa was a nice man, but as a professor... do not take this class. As an education major, this class was one I wish I hadn't have taken. He is very political and if you have no previous background knowledge on Latinx history, you will struggle. We read ~2 LONG articles a week (typically). Pop quizzes are 1Q. I don't recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Hinojosa is a very knowledgeable professor and it is extremely easy to get an A in this class. He offers a TON of extra credit and while his pop quizzes are textbook based they are very easy. He does however make his political beliefs extremely obvious which can get frustrating at times, but he is a very funny and kind prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Hinojosa is such an amazing guy. His passion for teaching is admirable and he does everything within his power to make sure students not only enjoy his course, but succeed. If you went to high school in the US, get ready to reexamine everything you were taught in history. This class not only makes you grow as a student, but a person as well.

DR. Hinojosa truly cares for his students. I loved going to class and he was super interactive in lectures. He has 5 pop quizzes throughout the semester of the daily readings. He also had four exams that are open note and were completely online. He gave many options for extra credit. His class is up to date and relates to many issues today.

Dr. Hinojosa is the best! He makes history enjoyable and engages with the class. I looked forward to this class and his perspective. Just pay attention and take notes in class and you will get an A. Tests are open note. Best professor ever!!

SUCH a great prof. I've met few others who care this much about their students. Not going to lie though, this class was a lot of work. Readings before every class, discussions, multiple essays, a midterm, a final project, and pop quizzes. But he's super understanding with extensions, and bc there is so much work it's easy to make up for a bad grade
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The best professor i have ever had, is super helpful, and his classes are always so fun. Would recommend him and this class to anyone!

reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I got an A in this class, but would NEVER take it again. Hinojosa is a smart guy but his class is incredibly time consuming and very frustrating. Even if you read, you might not pass the pop quizzes and you have to write 5 papers, 2 book reports and a 2500 word final essay. The only reason I got an A is because I did 7 extra credit assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would only take this if you HAVE to. While you learn a lot, it is very political. I felt like the outsider in this class because I am white. You have 2 book reviews due within a week of each other and then 2500 word essay due for final. You have to read to pass pop quizzes. Lots of extra credit. You can do it , just def. not my fav class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers
